name: demo
description: A live example in a box the reader can drag narrower and wider, with a bar naming the example and the width stop the box is at, and the code beneath it.

attributes.name: data-height
attributes.description: The preview box's height. A frame inside cannot size to its content, so this is where that is set; with data-resize="both" it is the starting height.

attributes.name: data-width
attributes.description: The preview box's starting width, before the reader drags it. Full width when absent.

attributes.name: data-resize
attributes.description: Which way the reader can drag the box: its width only, or both width and height.

attributes.name: data-stylesheet
attributes.description: Read by the module: the stylesheet the frame it builds should load, when it is not the host page's own yeti.css; yeti.js is expected beside it.

children.description: A title for the demo, above the box.

The resizable box: a bar naming the example across the top, then the example. Holds an iframe with the example in srcdoc, or the example's markup directly on a page that already loads Yeti. A box holding direct markup carries tabindex="0" because it scrolls; a framed box does not need one, because the iframe fills it exactly.

The framed example, loading yeti.css and yeti.js alone so the host page's styles never reach it and every module is present. Needs a title. With the module, an iframe without srcdoc, or an empty box, is filled from the code under the box.
The code, collapsed: a summary reading View Code, plain text that underlines under the pointer, and a pre.

markers.name: data-preview
markers.description: Marks the resizable box and names the example; the bar across the top of the box shows the value. Direct markup taller than the box scrolls, so a box holding it carries tabindex="0" to stay reachable from the keyboard; a framed box does not.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-md
tokens.description: Padding of the framed document's body, written by the module.

tokens.name: --yeti-height-md
tokens.description: Box height at data-height="md" and by default. The sm, lg, and xl stops of the same family are read through the shared height mapping in layouts/attributes.css, not by this file.

tokens.name: --yeti-height-sm
tokens.description: The shortest the box can be dragged when data-resize allows height.

tokens.name: --yeti-demo-border
tokens.description: The box's edge, and the rule under the bar.

tokens.name: --yeti-demo-radius
tokens.description: The box's corner, and the stop label's.

tokens.name: --yeti-demo-label
tokens.description: Surface of the bar.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-text
tokens.description: The bar's text, the summary's under the pointer, and the tint mixed into the stop label's surface.

tokens.name: --yeti-weight-strong
tokens.description: Weight of the example's name in the bar.

tokens.name: --yeti-control-border
tokens.description: The rule under the summary when the pointer reaches it.

tokens.name: --yeti-width-xs
tokens.description: The narrowest the box can be dragged.

tokens.name: --yeti-border-width
tokens.description: Width of the box's edge, the bar's rule, and the summary's underline.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-xs
tokens.description: Clearance direct markup keeps from the box's resize grip; the bar's block padding; the stop label's offset and inline padding.

tokens.name: --yeti-space-sm
tokens.description: The bar's inline padding, and the stop label's inset from the end.

tokens.name: --yeti-text-sm
tokens.description: Text size of the caption, the bar, the stop label, and the summary.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-text-muted
tokens.description: The caption's color, the stop label's, and the summary's at rest.

tokens.name: --yeti-font-mono
tokens.description: The stop label's typeface, so it reads as a readout, not prose.

tokens.name: --yeti-leading-md
tokens.description: Line height of the bar and the stop label.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-border-strong
tokens.description: The grip at rest.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-focus
tokens.description: The grip and the box's end edge while the grip is hovered, focused or dragged.

tokens.name: --yeti-color-surface
tokens.description: The two short lines across the grip.

tokens.name: --yeti-radius-full
tokens.description: The grip's pill shape.

tokens.name: --yeti-duration-fast
tokens.description: The grip's and the edge's color change when engaged.

keyboard.action: On the summary, opens or closes the code.
On the grip (with the module), widens or narrows the box to the next width stop; mirrored in a right-to-left page.
On the grip (with the module), takes the box to its narrowest or widest.

a11y.notes: Give the iframe a title. Give a box holding direct markup tabindex="0": markup taller than the box scrolls, and a scrollable region must be reachable from the keyboard. A framed box does not need one, because the iframe fills it exactly and it never scrolls. With the module, the box's width is moved by a grip, a separator named "Resize" and the example's name, valued in pixels with the width stop as its text, that a mouse, a finger or the keyboard can move. Without it the resize handle is the browser's; a keyboard or touch reader then sees the demo at its starting size. Either way the code is there, so a demo must never be the only place the markup appears. The bar and the stop label are generated content and are not announced; the name in data-preview is a visual heading for the box, and the iframe's title carries the same name to assistive tech. A frame the module creates is titled from that name too.
